extraction_notes: Digitised SI catalytic-performance figures visible in the supplied SI page images: SI Figure S20, SI Figure S21, and SI Figure S22. Values are approximate readings from marker centres or bar tops. SI Figure S22 uses the left axis for CO2 conversion (solid lines) and the right axis for methanol selectivity (dashed lines). Other SI performance figures mentioned in captions (e.g., SI Figures S17 and S19) were not present as readable page images in the prompt, so no plotted points were extracted from them.
